features.name: Screen recording
features.gate: web feature("screen-recording") in views/ScreenRec.tsx, views/SettingsGroups.tsx; mac Features.on("screen-recording") in ScreenRec.swift (SRController.gateOpen); 12b island moments, meeting question and performance watch: ScreenRecIsland.sync() starts no clock while the gate is closed, and the page sends no meeting while it is off (core/screenrecmeet.ts). 12c cloud upload, the Recordings list and the player: ScreenRecCloud.sync() stops every timer, the network watch and every read while the gate is closed, its ops answer nothing, and the page asks for the list only when the feature is on (soundboard/Recordings.tsx, views/ScreenRecCloud.tsx).
